content: macOS menu bar conventions (Apple MenuBarExtra docs): LSUIElement hides Dock icon; a menu-bar-only app is automatically terminated if user removes the extra; isInserted binding tracks visibility; .window style renders data-rich popover with standard controls; menu bar icon uses 18x18 template NSImage for dark/light compatibility. Competitor conventions (CodexBar, TokenBar): dynamic bar icons whose fill/color reflects remaining quota; icon dims when last refresh failed; hover tooltip; click opens popover with Refresh/Quit/Settings actions; Sparkle in-app updates; keyboard shortcut to open menu.
